target_material: ZnAl-layered double hydroxide (ZnAl-LDH) and ZnAl/H11546MMO framework
summary: The study describes the fabrication of a hierarchical ZnAl/H11546MMO framework through a biotemplated synthesis method. A uniform Al2O3 coating was deposited on a legume template using atomic layer deposition (ALD), followed by in situ growth of ZnAl-LDH and subsequent calcination to form the MMO framework. The resulting material exhibits enhanced photocatalytic performance due to its hierarchical structure and high surface area.
evidence: A uniform Al2O3 coating was deposited on the surface of the biotemplate with an atomic layer deposition (ALD) process, and the film of ZnAl-layered double hydroxide (ZnAl-LDH), which faithfully inherits the surface structure of the biotemplate, was prepared by an in situ growth technique. The sample was calcined at 500 °C for 6 h to form the ZnAl/H11546MMO framework.
